# DSH Remote
> Continue your DSH work from a phone or another computer: read sessions, answer approvals and quest
ions, transfer files, and inspect the host.
**English** · 简体中文
DSH Remote consists of a DSH plugin, a single-file gateway, and clients. The plugin adds the DSH ent
ry point and manages the gateway. The gateway handles authentication, HTTP/realtime proxying, and fi
les. Clients include Android, mobile/desktop WebUI, and the HarmonyOS source project.
Documentation · Installation · Troubleshooting · Downloads · Issues
For task-based instructions and AI-assisted diagnosis, use the operation and troubleshooting knowled
ge base (Chinese) or the AI reading index. The plugin includes the same knowledge base as offline Do
) or the AI reading index. The plugin includes the same knowledge base as offline Doctor references.
The detailed guides are currently in Chinese. This page and the plugin README provide an English ove
rview and installation path.
The current source is **0.8.0-rc.9** (2026-10-22), a candidate for validation before the stable rele
ase. See the rc.9 notes for scope and evidence; a local candidate does not establish npm or GitHub r
elease availability.
## Capabilities
| Area | Features |
| Sessions | History and realtime messages, model/reasoning selection, approvals, questions, goals,

queues, subagents and turn branches |
| Learning and diagnosis | Eight-step mobile guide, read-only

AI diagnosis, local operation logs and feedback |
| Files and images | Host browsing, previews, down

loads, resumable chunks and image attachments |
| Host status | Gateway/DSH status, mux/host channel

s, devices, tokens and cost estimates |
| Plugins | Installed/discovered plugins, details, configura

tion toggles and operation records |
| Session insights | Optional dsh-context summaries and dsh-cos

t-meter costs/quotas |
| Weak networks and recovery | Independent long polling, WS backoff, local hi

story, gzip/ETag and bounded crash recovery |
| Connections and themes | Multiple pairing addresses,
groups, LAN/Tailscale and six Web themes; Blue Fat Fish is the default |
Mobile navigation is **Sessions, Files, More**. The session home shows workspaces, recent sessions a
nd items needing attention. More groups host connections, plugins, receipts and preferences. Desktop
uses the same three entry points with a wider conversation layout. See platform differences.
The mobile guide teaches connection, chat, files, branches, diagnosis and feedback. Finishing or ski
pping the entire guide removes its home invitation; reopen it at **More → Preferences and maintenanc
e → Getting started**. Blue Fat Fish applies when no valid theme is saved; existing selections are p
ng started**. Blue Fat Fish applies when no valid theme is saved; existing selections are preserved.
Image understanding depends on DSH and the model. Cost estimates do not replace provider bills. Insi
ghts require the corresponding host plugins and display unavailable states when data is missing. DSH
UI renders a safe read-only subset.
## Quick start: DSH Web plugin
Confirm that DSH Web works, then run as the same user:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
1. Fully restart DSH Web, hard-refresh with Ctrl+F5, and use the left navigation's More → 手机连接（DSH R
emote） to open pairing in a browser. A first-use card explains where to find it; older hosts keep a

bottom-left connection button.
2. Confirm the gateway is running and open `http://127.0.0.1:8787/hea

lth` on the host.
3. Generate a connection QR in the plugin wizard or admin console and scan it in M

ore → Hosts and connections → Scan to connect. The APK download QR only installs the app.
4. For man
ual pairing, use `http://PC-LAN-IP:8787` and the token. A phone's localhost refers to the phone.
The example targets the `web` profile; use your actual profile name. DSH Desktop uses its own plugin
manager and requires a complete exit/reopen. Installing into Web does not install into Desktop. For
a published candidate, use its exact `@<version>`; check npm before relying on `@next` or `@latest`
a published candidate, use its exact `@<version>`; check npm before relying on `@next` or `@latest`.
For standalone gateways, multiple addresses, pinned versions and Git-source installation, see the in
stallation guide. A standalone executable can run with `--supervise`; defaults are `0.0.0.0:8787` an
> Pairing QR codes contain credentials. Use a trusted LAN or Tailscale; keep tokens private and avoi
d directly exposing the gateway to the public Internet.
## Screenshots
Captured on 2026-10-22: **rc.9 mobile WebUI** with an isolated test host and sample data, showing th
e default fish skin and the updated More page. These are browser captures, not Android device captur
es. Older emulator, desktop and admin images remain in the screenshot archive with provenance.

ote-linux-x64`, grant executable permission |

WebUI |

nd run an isolated startup smoke check; no Apple notarization. Intel uses the plugin or source; see
ated startup smoke check; no Apple notarization. Intel uses the plugin or source; see installation |

t public distribution or all device acceptance checks are complete.
